themes.evidence: Familiarity with agentic patterns and experience instrumenting/monitoring AI workflows in production.
Hands-on experience building LLM-powered workflows (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar)
move quickly from prototype to production, measure adoption and impact
constrain outputs, build quality checks and monitoring so workflows can be trusted in production
Partner with SalesOps, Enablement, GTM Systems on requirements, rollout, governance, production deployment.
translate ambiguous needs into shippable solutions, care deeply whether what you build is adopted

archetype_rationale: The role is a hands-on builder who ships LLM-powered workflows, agents, and connectors from prototype to production, applying agentic patterns with quality checks and monitoring. The day-to-day is building and operationalizing AI workflows, not embedding with external clients or producing dashboards.
notes: Strong GTM/Salesforce integration flavor (APIs, automation platforms, CRM hygiene) leans toward RPA, but the 'agents/connectors/quality checks' framing makes agent-builder the dominant archetype. SQL is mentioned but only as supporting comfort, not a dashboards/analytics core.
